title: Widen the route tool surface to what slice 2 actually needs
action:
Slice 2 gives route four new powers, and each one needs exactly one more verb on `ROUTE_ALLOWED_TOOLS` in `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/control_loop.rs`. Add ONLY these, keeping the verb-by-verb style and never reaching for the `Bash(.bee/bin/bee:*)` wildcard:

1. **Start a reviewer** — `Bash(.bee/bin/bee herding run:*)` and `Bash(.bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare:*)`. Route dispatches through the one door like every other caller.
2. **Record a verdict** — `Bash(.bee/bin/bee reviews:*)`. The review store is create/record/status/candidate; route needs all of them and they are all under one verb.
3. **Write the CHANGES cell** — `Bash(.bee/bin/bee cells add:*)` and `Bash(.bee/bin/bee cells list:*)` (list is already there).
4. **The two markers** — `Bash(mkdir:*)` and `Bash(touch:*)` for `.bee/tmp/bee-herding.review.<slug>` and `.bee/tmp/bee-herding.blocked.<slug>`, plus `Bash(rm:*)`. The merge role already carries `mkdir`/`touch` for exactly this pattern; route additionally needs `rm` because unlike merge it CLEARS its own marker when a verdict lands. `ls` is already there for reading them.
5. **The waiting-on mark** — `Bash(.bee/bin/bee state waiting-on:*)`.

What must still be ABSENT, and is asserted by the existing `ROUTE_FORBIDDEN_TOOL_TOKENS` test: `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash(git:*)`, `Bash(herdr:*)`, `Bash(tmux:*)`, `Bash(.bee/bin/bee:*)`, `Task`. Add two more forbidden tokens while you are here, because slice 2 is exactly when someone would be tempted: `Bash(.bee/bin/bee worktree merge` and `Bash(.bee/bin/bee gate`. Route never merges and never approves a gate.

Update the doc comment above the constant to say what slice 2 added and why each verb is there. Extend the existing tests rather than adding parallel ones: the forbidden-token test gains the two new tokens, and the both-transports test still has to pass unchanged.

truths: every new verb is enumerated, and the bee CLI wildcard is still absent
the forbidden-token list gains `bee worktree merge` and `bee gate`, and the test asserts them
the surface is still the identical string on both transports
the three existing roles' surfaces are still byte-unchanged
